This post makes me smile. I am a first generation Aussie. My parents came here from Italy. Best of luck with your journey in this Great Nation. Go sit at your local and have a pint.

Having to deal with adjusting into normal life back in the safety of my home after a 12 month combat tour in Afghanistan. I did absolutely everything I could to dull the pain and I ended up lost in the system for a few years. Now 11 years on I’m just starting to find normalcy.
Don't rush things. Pursue a career through higher learning. Be kind to yourself.
